_note: Human scale: the factory's golden record. One table of the adult human body; every object type says how it meets the body (factory/reference_handbook.json 'contacts'), and the drawing's own proportions give everything else. No product dimensions are looked up. Values are general adult anthropometry, sexes combined, approximate 5th / 50th / 95th percentiles in millimetres; ranges matter more than the middle.

measures_why.ear_to_mouth: ear canal to the middle of the lips, straight line: what a handset must span
measures_why.popliteal_height: floor to the underside of the knee, seated: seat height
measures_why.buttock_popliteal_length: back of the buttock to the back of the knee: seat depth
measures_why.fingertip_breadth: index finger across the last joint: holes and buttons a finger goes into or presses
measures_why.grip_diameter: comfortable power grip: handles and rails
measures_why.palm_breadth: across the knuckles: openings a hand goes through
